prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in League City, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1117; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine, we'll get to it. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was at the intersection in League City, the one with the four-way signal near the shopping center. I was going through on the green.
Q: Which direction were you traveling?
A: Heading east, in the left lane, because I was going to turn at the next light.
Q: What did you see as you entered the intersection?
A: A pickup coming from the north side. I think it had just switched from yellow. I didn't have time to brake all the way, and it hit the driver's side of my car.
Q: Did you notice the light color on your side when you started through?
A: Yes, it was green. I'd been waiting behind a couple of cars, so I was moving at maybe thirty miles an hour.
Q: Were you able to get out of the vehicle on your own?
A: I got out, but my neck was stiff right away, and by the evening my lower back was really sore. I've been taking it easy since.
Q: Have you seen a doctor or other provider for those symptoms?
A: I went to urgent care the next day. They said it was a strain and gave me a muscle relaxer and told me to follow up.
Q: Did you have any problems with your neck or back before this collision?
A: Not that I remember. I've had an occasional backache from lifting, but nothing that kept me from working.
Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about how the accident happened?
A: Only that I was careful and the other driver seemed to be in a hurry. That's about it.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Okay, thanks.
